Class SelectSqlParser

Namespace
Tripous.Data
Assembly
Tripous.Data.dll

A simple SELECT Sql parser. It parses a SELECT statement into its constituents parts. The SELECT statement can contain nested sub-SELECTs or column names in double quotes or angle brackets.
